source_note: Windmemories于2025年6月29日实拍法王寺一号塔。下部塔身被树木遮挡，因此仅画十五重密檐与现状残损塔顶局部，以未闭合的下缘表示取景边界，不复原隐藏的南面券门与台基。2014年远景及同日横幅实拍另存作核查背景，未传入生成。
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the Fawang pagoda upper-tower line drawing TO CORRECT. Its current eave count is thirteen; correct it to EXACTLY FIFTEEN principal projecting eaves. Add TWO complete masonry eave tiers between the existing upper and lower groups, with proportionally closer vertical spacing so all FIFTEEN tiers fit within the same1024x1536 canvas and taper smoothly. Think five top eaves + five middle eaves + five lower eaves = fifteen total. Each tier has one principal projecting roof/corbel silhouette; thin horizontal corbel sub-lines are not additional tiers. Keep the actual squat broken crown, modern thin rod, small arch niches, two square faces, unfinished lower crop; no restored ancient finial, hidden lower base or doorway. Image2 is the real photographed geometry, Image3 line technique. All thin neutral black contours printed on a perfectly flat OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, inside and outside the monument. No filled gray areas, shadows, transparency, haze, glow, paper texture, color, checkerboard, text or watermark. Output RGB or alpha255 everywhere. Keep complete crown with clear margin and each of FIFTEEN distinct projecting eaves clearly readable.

site_recommendation.lede: 方形砖塔的十五重密檐层层外叠，向上收成柔和的曲线。图版截取法王寺唐塔的上部，留下砖檐、圆券小孔和残损塔顶之间的节奏。
facts: 所绘主体 选法王寺塔群中的十五级方形密檐大塔，按唐代遗存登记，不将附近元、清塔的纪年混入。
砖檐曲线 塔身以上十五重叠涩密檐逐级收分，整体呈抛物线轮廓；塔顶宝刹已损毁。
局部取景 实拍下部塔身被树木遮挡，图版只绘上部密檐及现状塔顶，不复原券门、台基或完整古代塔刹。

checks: 重试十五重主要出檐逐级核对，首稿十三重拒绝交付。
现状残损塔顶、细杆、小拱孔及局部下缘保留，不复原被树遮挡的下部。
纯白底细黑线，无背景、文字或灰面。

Image2 is actual monument GEOMETRY: the Tang-era No.1 main pagoda at Fawang Temple (法王寺塔), Dengfeng, Henan. Draw the visible UPPER TOWER LOCAL DETAIL: its exact FIFTEEN main projecting dense eaves, the small centered round-arched apertures between them, tapering square tower silhouette and the PRESENT broken squat ornamental crown with a thin modern rod above it. Do not invent an intact ancient tall finial. Count fifteen principal projecting eaves, not the broken crown molding. Retain a modest oblique nearly frontal view exposing two square faces; verticals vertical. The photograph conceals the lower tall shaft behind trees: do NOT reconstruct its lower doorway, platform or base. End the drawing with a short segment below the lowest eave and a restrained irregular unfinished contour to show this is an upper-tower study, not a full pagoda. Entire depicted upper tower and crown fit with clear margins, portrait1024x1536, approx82% height. Only a few fine parallel strokes per corbel eave; no dense brickwork. Thin neutral black outlines on perfectly flat OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. All spaces and masonry planes between ink lines stay white. The production original must have NO transparency: RGB or RGBA alpha255 EVERYWHERE. No shading, gray fill, texture, gradient, glow, cast shadow, color, checkerboard, text or watermark. Remove trees, vegetation, mountains, neighboring towers and sky. One isolated upper tower study.
